### Historical audit

**Source:** A0009, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/teacher_human_archive/public_package/teacher_self_evolution_human_pilot/tasks/D01_M0_R2/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below refer to this file’s JSONL lines; character ranges are half-open.

**Inferred goal:** Construct a warm living-room scene. The original task and reference are not supplied, so matching any intended image is unverified.

| Evidence | Observed operation or result |
|---|---|
| Scene construction: execute step 1, line 1 [0,7202); step 2, line 5 [0,6814) | Code specifies multiple objects: sofa, coffee table, two place settings, flowers and curtain. It assigns colors and a porcelain material with roughness, but no image textures are evident in the code. Separate cup bodies and handles, table legs, foliage stems, cushions and tilted pillows are specified; physical connection, intersections and final pose are not independently verified. |
| Initial failure: execution_result step 1, line 4 [0,2693) | Build failed because the left pillow fillet exceeded half its smallest dimension; no image was returned. This was a construction-parameter failure, not a timeout or demonstrated render failure. |
| Revision: execute step 2, line 5 [0,6814) | The actor reduced both pillow fillets to 0.11 and also reduced fillets on the saucers, inset, pot rim and curtain folds. This is an executed revision, not an empty patch. The trace shows no intervening teacher message; the error result is the visible feedback motivating the retry, though the actor’s reasoning is not recorded. |
| Validation: build_completed and render_completed step 2, lines 7 [0,1328) and 9 [0,1315); execution_result, line 10 [0,73850); select, line 11 [0,59) | Build and render completed with return code zero, a PNG path was returned, and step 2 was selected. Code specifies a camera, two area lights and ambient world. The image itself is not visible here, so framing, lighting, material appearance, occlusion and render quality remain unknown. |

**Role and outcome.** This is an archive trace of scene-building executions, not evidence of teacher feedback delivered to a student: no teacher detection, diagnosis, proposed update, student receipt or adoption appears in the supplied events. The retry is visible autonomous iteration after a tool error, but broader exploration is not shown. The execution was **technically successful on retry**; formal task success and visual correctness remain unknown. There is no evidence of a technical interruption after the successful render.

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, the observed exception identifies the fillet-radius constraint, and a build/render check distinguishes an executable scene from a failed build. The particular radii, arrangement, colors and camera are task-specific. Whether handles touch cups, objects sit correctly, textures look convincing, or the composition matches the missing reference are unresolved hypotheses—not established by names, code intent or the successful render log.
